description: How securely the evidence is tied to its Pleiades place. For region_only and unlocated, validate.ts additionally requires place.note to say what is actually known.

terms.definition: The identification with the Pleiades place is undisputed.
The identification is generally accepted but rests on inference (find-spot, textual emendation, onomastics).
The identification is disputed or conjectural; the Pleiades URI records the leading candidate.
The evidence locates only to a region or province. The Pleiades URI points at the region's own place resource, not a settlement.
No accepted identification with any Pleiades place. pleiades_uri is omitted; the item is recorded but cannot appear on the map.
